scenarios.title: Prepared scope and all filters remain server-owned
scenarios.given: An isolated prepared city with five synthetic properties and median 951220 minor units per m².
scenarios.when: Apply each published filter independently through the Filters editor.
scenarios.then: URL minor units and actual rows/count/median match the public API; identical and zero outcomes remain truthful.
scenarios.journey: Prepared scope and all filters remain server-owned

verification.oracle: Ticket 6.6 intent contract and independently parsed prepared public API.
verification.method: Real Chromium plus Supertest response readback; no fixture membership changes.

scenarios.title: Every ordering and cursor page comes from the server

scenarios.then: Server order and full-result median are retained while pages append and input changes reset the cursor.
scenarios.journey: Every ordering and cursor page comes from the server
